consistency.note: Month YYYY for jobs, YYYY for the club; titles match; superlatives repeated across every section

contact_info.note: City, email, phone and a profile link in the header

formatting.note: Standard headings, reverse-chronological; summary paragraph; one image on a non-academic résumé; two fonts

keyword_alignment.note: Reconciliation, proposals, RMDs and custodian platforms appear in a few bullets; most bullets are adjectives and tools appear only in the list

length.note: One page for two years of experience

parseability.note: Single column, clean text layer (0.95), standard headings, contact in the first two lines

quantification.note: No bullet contains a number tied to an outcome; rankings are asserted without a population or metric

fixes.fix: Before: "#1 ranked analyst in the firm for overall performance and client impact" → After: "Supported __ advisors with $__M in client assets; cut quarterly review prep from __ to __ days"
fixes.issue: 15 of 24 bullets are ranking claims with no number, issuer or population

fixes.fix: Lead each role with the concrete tasks and their volumes (accounts reconciled per month, proposals produced, assets covered)
fixes.issue: Superlatives replace the work: reconciliation, proposals and RMD processing appear once each

fixes.fix: Remove every evaluative adjective; keep only facts a reference could confirm
fixes.issue: Superlatives ("world-class", "elite", "best") repeat in profile, experience, education, skills and volunteer sections

fixes.fix: Remove the image; parsers drop it and some recruiters discount it
fixes.issue: A photo or logo image is present on a non-academic résumé

fixes.fix: Add the GPA if 3.5 or above, or omit the "elite academic performance" line
fixes.issue: Education lists no GPA, honors or graduation detail beyond the year

card.headline: Financial analyst, 2 years at a regional wealth-management firm; T3 finance degree; Series 7 and 66
leadership: Volunteer instructor in a financial-literacy program, 2024-present

education.institution: Arizona State University, W. P. Carey School of Business
education.notes: GPA omitted; "elite academic performance" claimed without a number or honor

bullets_condensed: Quarterly client review materials for advisors' books
Monthly reconciliation of custodian data against the portfolio-reporting system
Prospect proposals with asset-allocation summaries and fee illustrations
Account openings, transfers and required minimum distributions with operations
Account paperwork and CRM record updates
Stock pitches in a student club; no fund, AUM or results stated

leadership.highlight: Volunteer instructor since 2024; "best volunteer instructor" claim has no issuer

red_flags.detail: "#1 ranked analyst in the firm", "best in the office", "consistently ranked first in every internal review": no issuer, population or metric
"Best intern in the history of the program" and "offered a full-time position ahead of all other interns" with no cohort size
"World-class", "elite", "unmatched work ethic" and "exceptional leadership ability" stand where tasks and numbers should be
"Elite academic performance" and "one of the top students in the program" with GPA omitted and no honors listed

finance.rationale: Wealth management at a regional firm is C-tier; the actual work is reconciliation, proposals and paperwork with no AUM, revenue or client numbers. Series 7 and 66 are neutral. "#1 ranked", "best in the firm" and "top performer" have no issuer or population and carry no weight.
top_evidence: Reconciliation, proposals and account paperwork at a regional wealth-management firm
No deal, market or portfolio figure anywhere on the page

general.rationale: Two years of client-service work at a C-tier wealth-management firm, a T3 finance degree with GPA omitted, two licenses, and a club role. Every ranking claim lacks an issuer, metric or population and is discounted to zero; what remains is routine support work.
top_evidence: Financial analyst at a regional wealth-management firm since 2024

strengths: Converted an internship into a full-time analyst seat at the same firm
Series 7 and Series 66 obtained in the first year of full-time work
A handful of bullets name real wealth-management tasks (custodian reconciliation, proposals, RMDs)
analysis.verdict: Two years of wealth-management support work wrapped in rankings no one issued; without the adjectives the record is routine entry-level.
weaknesses: "#1 ranked", "world-class", "best in the firm" and "top performer" appear in nearly every bullet with no issuer, metric or population
No number anywhere: no assets covered, advisors supported, accounts, proposals or outcomes
GPA omitted while claiming "elite academic performance"
The role is client-service support at a regional wealth-management firm; the substance is entry level
Interests and volunteer lines also carry self-rankings, which undercuts the whole page

verdict.reason: Résumé with dated roles and education.

text:
[name]
Scottsdale, AZ | [email] | [phone] | [url]

PROFILE
World-class financial analyst and #1 ranked performer with two years of elite experience in wealth management. Recognized as the best in the firm for client results, analytical excellence and leadership. A top performer who consistently exceeds every expectation and delivers best-in-class outcomes for high-net-worth clients.

EXPERIENCE

Desert Ridge Wealth Partners — Scottsdale, AZ
Financial Analyst | July 2024 – Present
- #1 ranked analyst in the firm for overall performance and client impact
- Deliver world-class portfolio analysis and reporting for high-net-worth clients, recognized by leadership as the best in the office
- Top performer in client retention, with the strongest results in the firm
- Built best-in-class financial models that set a new standard for the analyst team
- Praised by senior advisors as the most talented analyst they have worked with
- Selected as the go-to analyst for the firm's most important clients because of elite attention to detail
- Consistently ranked first in every internal review and evaluation
- Drive exceptional results on every project with unmatched work ethic
- Lead the preparation of quarterly client review materials for advisors' books
- Reconcile client account data between the custodian platform and the firm's portfolio reporting system each month
- Prepare proposals for prospective clients, including asset allocation summaries and fee illustrations
- Coordinate with the operations team on account openings, transfers and required minimum distributions
- Handpicked by the managing partner to represent the firm at a national industry conference because of elite presentation skills

Desert Ridge Wealth Partners — Scottsdale, AZ
Summer Intern, Client Service | June 2023 – August 2023
- Rated the best intern in the history of the program
- Delivered world-class support to advisors and clients
- Recognized as a top performer and offered a full-time position ahead of all other interns
- Prepared account paperwork and updated client records in the CRM

Arizona State University Investment Club — Tempe, AZ
Analyst | 2022 – 2024
- Top-ranked analyst in the club with the highest-quality stock pitches
- Named best presenter at the annual pitch competition by popular opinion

EDUCATION
Arizona State University, W. P. Carey School of Business — Tempe, AZ
B.S. in Finance, May 2024
- Elite academic performance and recognized as one of the top students in the program
- Completed the most rigorous finance coursework offered
- Coursework: Corporate Finance, Investments, Portfolio Management, Financial Statement Analysis, Derivatives

CERTIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
- Series 7 and Series 66 (2024)
- World-class Excel skills; best-in-class financial modeling and valuation
- Expert in Morningstar Direct, eMoney, Salesforce and Bloomberg
- Elite communication and presentation skills; exceptional leadership ability
- Unmatched work ethic and the highest standards of integrity

VOLUNTEER
- Volunteer, Junior Achievement financial literacy program, 2024 – Present (recognized as the best volunteer instructor in the chapter)

INTERESTS
Golf (club champion caliber), competitive running, mentoring the next generation of top performers
